_about: The office's settings, written by tools/make-office.py between the office:settings markers in netlify/cb/lib.mjs, the only copy the server reads. The pipelines and their stages are EspoCRM's, word for word and in its order (read 2026-10-20): each stage says which status it puts a grant request in, and the first stage of each is where a new one starts. Statuses are EspoCRM's three. Amounts are whole dollars, as EspoCRM held every one.
